facts.headline: US Steel and Aluminum Tariffs: A Catalyst for Global Economic and Geopolitical Shifts
facts.summary: The enforcement of US steel and aluminum tariffs has triggered market jitters, retaliation threats, and supply-chain recalculations. Read through collapse, the tariffs are best understood not as an isolated trade measure but as an accelerant of a global order already drifting from integration toward fragmentation.
